newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman raises BMW target.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman raises BMW target.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said on Thursday it raised its price target on BMW to 1,600 marks from 1,300 marks, reflecting prospects that the company will adopt more liberal accounting practices that will boost headline profits.

Analyst Chris Will at Lehman said the company had indicated it will adopt the International Accounting Standard, a move that would have the effect of lifting earnings per share in 1998 for example from an expected 70-75 marks to 90 marks.
He repeated an "outperform" rating on the stock.

Will said the move would symbolise BMW's transition from being a regional German company to an international auto group, adding that the adoption of international accounting standards would make international fund managers more comfortable holding the stock.
